edges.reason: transfer() forwards the call to _transfer with msg.sender as sender.
transferFrom() forwards the call to _transfer.
transferFrom() decreases the allowance through _approve.
approve() delegates allowance writing to _approve.
_transfer finalizes with a call to _tokenTransfer after all checks and swaps.
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth, performing an external swap before the sender/recipient balances are updated in _tokenTransfer.
_transfer sends the contract ETH to fee receivers before balances are updated.
swapTokensForEth invokes the external Uniswap router, handing control to an untrusted contract mid-flow.
sendETHToFee performs a native ETH transfer to fee wallet 1.
sendETHToFee performs a native ETH transfer to fee wallet 2.
openTrading forwards the whole contract ETH balance to the external router via addLiquidityETH.
openTrading calls the factory to create the pair, trusting its return value.
openTrading approves the router through _approve.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve before swapping.
_transfer reads the contract token balance via balanceOf for the swap.
balanceOf converts reflections to tokens via tokenFromReflection.
_transferStandard obtains transfer values from _getValues.
_getValues obtains token values from _getTValues.
_getValues obtains reflection values from _getRValues.
_getValues reads the current rate from _getRate.
_getRate derives the rate from _getCurrentSupply.
_transferStandard allocates the team fee via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard applies the fee via _reflectFee.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by the reflection fee using SafeMath subtraction.
tokenFromReflection divides the reflection amount by the dynamic rate, exposing precision/rate arithmetic.
msg.sender is used as the sender in transfer-initiated _transfer calls.
manualswap authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender with _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender with _feeAddrWallet1.
setBots is gated by the onlyOwner modifier which checks msg.sender.
openTrading is gated by the onlyOwner modifier which checks msg.sender.
setCooldownEnabled is gated by the onlyOwner modifier which checks msg.sender.
block.timestamp is used for the cooldown gate and written into the cooldown mapping, making trading timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is passed as the Uniswap deadline in openTrading.
block.timestamp is passed as the Uniswap deadline in swapTokensForEth.
_transfer reads and writes the per-address cooldown mapping.
_transfer writes the tax fee value into _feeAddr1.
_transfer writes the team fee value into _feeAddr2.
_getTValues consumes the tax fee percentage held in _feeAddr1.
_getTValues consumes the team fee percentage held in _feeAddr2.
_transfer enforces the required amount to be at most _maxTxAmount.
_transfer compares from/to against the uniswapV2Pair address.
swapTokensForEth reads the router to fetch WETH and to route the swap.
openTrading reads and assigns the router address.
openTrading assigns the created pair address.
The onlyOwner modifier of setBots reads _owner for the authorization check.
The onlyOwner modifier of delBot reads _owner for the authorization check.
setBots writes blacklist flags into the bots mapping.
_transfer requires the sender and recipient not to be blacklisted bots.
sendETHToFee uses _feeAddrWallet1 to receive half of the ETH.
sendETHToFee uses _feeAddrWallet2 to receive the other half of the ETH.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the destination of the native transfer unsafe operation.
_feeAddrWallet2 is the destination of the native transfer unsafe operation.
_transfer checks the fee-exclusion flags before applying swap/fee logic.
_approve writes the nested allowance mapping.
_transferStandard updates the sender and recipient reflection balances.
_reflectFee reads and reduces the total reflection supply.
_reflectFee accumulates the total token fees.
_transfer reads the inSwap guard before triggering a swap.
_transfer checks swapEnabled to decide whether to swap.
_transfer checks cooldownEnabled to apply the cooldown gate.
openTrading verifies and sets the tradingOpen flag.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to carry call data into _transfer's logic.
The to parameter only exists to carry the recipient into _transfer's logic.
The amount parameter of _transfer is only used inside that function.
The sender parameter is only consumed by _transferStandard balance updates.
The recipient parameter is only consumed by _transferStandard balance updates.
The tAmount parameter is only consumed by _transferStandard value derivation.
The tokenAmount parameter is only used to approve and swap inside swapTokensForEth.
The rAmount parameter is only used for the rate conversion check.
The bots_ array is only iterated to fill the bots mapping in setBots.
The loop counter i only exists inside the setBots loop.
The notbot parameter is only used to clear a blacklist flag in delBot.
The local holds the contract token balance used for the swap inside _transfer.
The local holds the contract ETH balance used for the fee send inside _transfer.
The owner parameter is only used for the allowance write in _approve.
The spender parameter is only used for the allowance write in _approve.
